meta.title: Trubbo: the quiz that reads aloud and hears your answers
meta.description: Trubbo is a fun quiz for iPhone, for road trips and parties. It reads every question aloud, you answer out loud, and every question is checked against sources before you play. In English, Slovak and Czech.
suggest.text: This page is also in English.
cta.beta: Try what’s new in the beta
hero.title: A quiz that reads you the questions and listens to your answers.
hero.lead: You answer in your own words. Try the first question right here.
demo.q: How many bones are inside an elephant's trunk?
demo.hint: Tap an answer. In the app you just say it out loud.
demo.why: There are none at all. The trunk is pure muscle.
how.title: How a quiz goes
s0.title: Pick categories and a language.
s0.body: History, sports, science, food and more. Play in English, Slovak or Czech, and set an age level so kids can play along.
s1.title: Trubbo reads the question aloud.
s1.body: Everyone hears it at once, even whoever has their hands full. Nobody has to look at the phone.
s2.title: You answer out loud.
s2.body: Just say it. When you can't talk, type it, or tap an option if the question has them.
s3.title: Meaning counts, not exact wording.
s3.body: “None at all, I think” counts too.
s4.title: A short explanation after every answer.
s4.body: You hear right away if it counts, and why the answer is what it is. Unlike quizzes from AI chats, every question is checked against sources before you play.
s5.title: See how it went.
s5.body: Every quiz ends with a score. At the end you can go back over every question: your answer, the right one and the source.
